aur_recipe.PKGBUILD:
# Repackage the Ubuntu-built release archive. No compilation takes place here.
# package-aur.sh supplies the version and checksum for this exact build.
pkgname=chartr-bin
pkgver=0.3.1
_upstream_version=0.3.1
pkgrel=1
pkgdesc='Agent multiplexer with persistent terminals'
arch=('x86_64')
url='https://github.com/rengwu/chartr'
license=('GPL-3.0-or-later' 'Apache-2.0')
depends=('glibc' 'gcc-libs' 'gtk3' 'webkit2gtk-4.1' 'libxcb'
         'libxkbcommon-x11' 'fontconfig' 'vulkan-icd-loader' 'xdg-utils')
optdepends=('xorg-xwayland: run under a Wayland desktop'
            'vulkan-driver: GPU rendering')
options=('!strip' '!debug')
provides=("chartr=$pkgver")
conflicts=('chartr')
source=("$url/releases/download/v$_upstream_version/chartr-$_upstream_version-linux-x86_64.tar.gz")
sha256sums=('043a2db3b2023b455c3a194d69c3e431804d80404d0e6bfa4e2e4f6dee20b2a3')

check() {
    local binary linkage
    for binary in chartr herdr; do
        if ! linkage=$(LC_ALL=C ldd "$srcdir/chartr-$_upstream_version-linux-x86_64/usr/lib/chartr/$binary" 2>&1); then
            printf '%s\n' "$linkage" >&2
            return 1
        fi
        if [[ "$linkage" == *'not found'* ]]; then
            printf '%s\n' "$linkage" >&2
            return 1
        fi
    done
    "$srcdir/chartr-$_upstream_version-linux-x86_64/usr/lib/chartr/herdr" --version
}

package() {
    cp -a "$srcdir/chartr-$_upstream_version-linux-x86_64/usr" "$pkgdir/"
    install -Dm644 "$srcdir/chartr-$_upstream_version-linux-x86_64/BUILD-INFO.txt" \
        "$pkgdir/usr/share/doc/chartr/BUILD-INFO.txt"
}
